row:
Sharan Physiotherapy Centre is a professional physiotherapy channel by Dr. Sharan, focused on pain relief, physiotherapy treatment, and sports injury rehabilitation.

This channel aims to educate patients, address common myths, and provide clear, reliable information about physiotherapy care. Content includes musculoskeletal conditions, sports injuries, post-operative rehabilitation, pain management, and movement-based recovery, explained in a simple and practical manner.

You will find patient education videos, condition-based explanations, exercise and rehabilitation guidance, sports injury awareness, and clinical insights.

Online consultations and guided rehabilitation programs are available for eligible musculoskeletal conditions. To begin tele-rehabilitation, please fill out the consultation form (link provided).

For regular updates and clinic-related content, follow us on Instagram: sharan.physiotherapy.centre

— Dr. Sharan
Consultant Physiotherapist

Move better. Live better.
